name: Particles
description: Small visible material suspended or moving through a scene. Entries identify the particles rather than changing the main subject or camera.
entries: wood shavings falling beside a workbench
fine flour dust above a mixing bowl
metal sparks scattering from a grinding wheel
ice crystals blowing from a frozen ridge
sea salt droplets carried inland by wind
seed fluff drifting from dried flower heads
paper scraps tumbling along a pavement
fine ash descending through still air
sawdust settling on nearby tools
grit thrown up beside a turning wheel
loose feathers suspended in a draft
dry snow grains streaming across an icy surface
floating embers
drifting dust motes
cherry blossom petals
pollen grains suspended near open flowers
windblown dry leaves
soap bubbles with thin iridescent surfaces
tiny droplets scattered above splashing water
confetti pieces settling at different heights
